notes: Breadboard hole names follow the image's row labels: the visual top half (rows f-j) is bank 'b' and the visual bottom half (rows a-e) is bank 't', as the printed labels run j..f then e..a.
Hole positions are estimated from the circuit image. The pot's two outer legs are in the lower half (columns 22 and 24) and its center leg is in the upper half (column 23, row f).
The resistor sits in row g, columns 3 to 6. The LED anode (bent, longer leg) is in column 6 and the cathode is in column 8. This matches the schematic: pin 9 -> resistor -> LED anode, cathode -> GND.
The Uno has three GND ports. GND.1 is assumed to be the digital-header GND, used for the LED return. GND.2 is assumed to be the power-header GND, used for the pot.
Pot outer pins: 5V on column 24 and GND on column 22. The pot is symmetric between GND and VCC, so the assignment is interchangeable.
Jumper wires are modelled as plain male-to-male jumper-wire parts. Wire colours are taken from the image.
